draft-copilot.summary: This source describes a small local web application designed to assist users during a live 12-team, full-PPR snake fantasy football draft on Sleeper. The main goal of the tool is to provide real-time pick tracking and recommendations based on expert consensus rankings.

key_points.fact: A small local web app ran alongside a live Sleeper fantasy football draft.
The app tracked every pick in real time and recommended who to take next.
The goal was a tool to use during a 12-team, full-PPR snake draft on Sleeper.
Recommendations should come from expert consensus rankings, not Sleeper's ADP.
The default rankings blend FantasyPros consensus and ESPN Field Yates PPR rankings.
A player on both lists gets FantasyPros_rank × 0.6 + ESPN_rank × 0.4, and the list is re-sorted by that blended score.
The app fetches picks every 3 seconds.
Sleeper's CDN caches the picks endpoint for up to 30 seconds.
My Team and Needs tracker automatically detects your own picks and slots them into starting slots.
Check for an API before building scraping or screenshot reading.

A screenshot app was rejected because reading text from images is unreliable.
The live companion was the easier option because Sleeper has a public, no-login JSON API for drafts.
The default rankings blend FantasyPros consensus and ESPN Field Yates PPR rankings.

The app fetches picks every 3 seconds.
Sleeper's CDN caches the picks endpoint for up to 30 seconds.
Best Available shows consensus rankings with anyone already drafted by any team removed.
My Team and Needs tracker automatically detects your own picks and slots them into starting slots.
Raw consensus rank answers who is the better player, but not who is the better pick right now.
The value model adds position scarcity as a secondary nudge to the raw consensus rank.

facts.fact: Breakaway is an intelligent data aggregator and plan adjuster.
Version 1.0 was the Initial PRD, including Whoop + Strava + TrainerRoad + Garmin + MyFitnessPal scope.
Version 1.1 updated the API feasibility, making Strava the primary pipe, native nutrition logger, and TrainerRoad recommendation approach.
Breakaway is positioned as a data aggregator and plan adjuster, not a from-scratch AI plan generator.

Breakaway maintains a curated library of race-specific plan templates (e.g., Berkeley Hills Road Race, flat criterium, gravel 100-miler). The AI adjusts workouts within these templates based on wearable inputs.
Breakaway aggregates wearable data, maps it to a race-specific coaching template, and tells you exactly what to change — today.
Breakaway assigns a proven, race-specific coaching template to the athlete after they select their target race through a structured onboarding questionnaire.
Every day, Breakaway pulls data from connected wearables, evaluates it against the template, and recommends specific adjustments in plain English through Max — its AI coaching layer.
TrainerRoad provides structured workouts, FTP progression, and plan templates.
Whoop provides HRV, sleep staging, and recovery score but does not know what the plan says or if a workout is appropriate for the day.
The missing layer sits above the data and translates it into a single, actionable daily recommendation tied to a specific race goal.
